SELECT
  case when valid_order_count = 0 then null else net_sales_cents / valid_order_count end AS avg_order_value
  , case when buyer_count = 0 then null else net_sales_cents / buyer_count end AS avg_buyer_value
  , case when buyer_count = 0 then null else valid_order_count / buyer_count end AS purchase_frequency
  , case when payment_cents = 0 then null else refund_cents / payment_cents end AS refund_amount_rate
  , case when order_count = 0 then null else cancelled_order_count / order_count end AS cancel_rate
  , case when paid_order_count = 0 then null else refund_order_count / paid_order_count end AS refund_order_rate
  , case when gross_cents = 0 then null else discount_cents / gross_cents end AS discount_rate
  , case when valid_order_count = 0 then null else valid_order_items / valid_order_count end AS items_per_order
FROM (
  SELECT
    SUM(case when status = 'paid' then paid_cents - refund_cents else 0 end) AS net_sales_cents
    , SUM(CASE WHEN case when status = 'paid' and paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 then order_id end IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS valid_order_count
    , COUNT(DISTINCT case when status = 'paid' and paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 then member_id end) AS buyer_count
    , SUM(case when status = 'paid' then refund_cents else 0 end) AS refund_cents
    , SUM(case when status = 'paid' then paid_cents else 0 end) AS payment_cents
    , SUM(CASE WHEN case when status = 'cancelled' then order_id end IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled_order_count
    , SUM(CASE WHEN order_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS order_count
    , SUM(CASE WHEN case when status = 'paid' and refund_cents > 0 then order_id end IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS refund_order_count
    , SUM(CASE WHEN case when status = 'paid' then order_id end IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS paid_order_count
    , SUM(case when status = 'paid' then gross_cents - paid_cents else 0 end) AS discount_cents
    , SUM(case when status = 'paid' then gross_cents else 0 end) AS gross_cents
    , SUM(case when status = 'paid' and paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 then quantity else 0 end) AS valid_order_items
  FROM "data"."main"."orders" orders_src_10000
  WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', ordered_at) BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
) subq_18

2026年8月（统计区间2026-08-01至2026-09-01）青禾客户整体口径下的指标如下（未加任何门店或分组筛选，统计单位为CRM会员账户）：
- 有效订单均额：37.15元/单
- 购买会员人均消费：66.87元/账户
- 购买频次：1.8单/账户
- 退款金额占比：15.75%
- 取消率：6.25%
- 退款订单率：13.33%
- 优惠率：4.19%
- 单均商品件数：约1.22件/单

口径说明：有效订单均额为净销售额除以有效订单数；购买会员人均消费为净销售额除以购买会员数；购买频次为有效订单数除以购买会员数；退款金额占比为退款金额除以实付金额；取消率为取消订单数除以创建订单数；退款订单率为退款订单数除以支付订单数；优惠率为优惠金额除以支付订单原价金额；单均商品件数为有效订单商品件数除以有效订单数。以上均为本月覆盖范围内数据的汇总结果。
